relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Studies have shown that vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and its receptor (VEGFR) are highly expressed in angiosarcoma.

relationships.subject: chemotherapy
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that chemotherapy [P = 0.038, HR: 0.442 (0.205-0,956)], and surgery [P = 0.028, HR: 0.407 (0.182--0.908)] effectively improved patient prognosis (Table 10).

key_findings: Review of 82 cases: surgery and chemotherapy improved prognosis of small intestinal angiosarcoma in multivariate Cox analysis
VEGF/VEGFR highly expressed in angiosarcoma; bevacizumab a potential target
